title: Customer Refund Dispute Resolution
core_conflict: A billing snapshot says a refund is denied, while later support evidence and policy exception notes require an approval path and customer notification.
required_constraints: include contradictory billing, support, and policy-exception evidence
include workspace files, support emails, task-board refund blockers, and customer-response calendar deadlines
include dynamic updates that change eligibility, approval authority, or communication status after early rounds
emphasize cross-channel evidence, contradictory account state, and side-effect email/task action
